title: pref/recents payload
description: UPSERT payload of pref/recents: the account's recent searches, the same on every device it signs in on. Last writer wins, and the list is one value: two devices' lists are never merged. Clearing the list is a DELETE with an empty payload, never an empty list. The server keeps only the latest list, and a DELETE removes it: no history of past searches is retained (sync.proto rule 6 RETENTION). Serialized, at most 8,166 bytes of UTF-8 as JSON.stringify writes it, under the Push cap MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES (65,536).

searches.description: 1 to 10 searches, the newest first, no two the same; a client also keeps no two that differ only in case (compared by toLowerCase), keeping the newer: the schema checks exact duplicates only.

items.description: What the user searched for, trimmed (no leading or trailing white space), not empty, 1 to 200 Unicode code points, with no control character and no lone surrogate. Private to the user: never logged.

edited_at.description: When the user made the edit, in the device's local time with its offset (at most ±18:00). Display only; never compared, never restamped.

tz.description: The device's IANA time zone at edit time, e.g. America/Chicago. Display only.
